scripts.dev:ai: cd services/ai && PADDLE_PDX_DISABLE_MODEL_SOURCE_CHECK=True uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.test: pnpm build:libs && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 --if-present run test && pnpm test:ai
scripts.test:ai: cd services/ai && PADDLE_PDX_DISABLE_MODEL_SOURCE_CHECK=True uv run pytest -q -m "not ocr"
scripts.seed: pnpm --filter @kyc-setu/db run seed && pnpm --filter @kyc-setu/api run seed:review
scripts.test:ai:ocr: cd services/ai && PADDLE_PDX_DISABLE_MODEL_SOURCE_CHECK=True uv run pytest -q -m ocr
